items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Did you ever know Jimmy Newton? I think they called him Jimbo. ... Oh, yeah, he used to play at Southern State, played a whole lot of clarinet, he was alright. I don't know, I couldn't bet on his music ability...

ctx.x: Oh, no, no. He was the brother-in-law of Sidney Veen, clarinet, Lunderville. Oh, he was a good musician. Did you ever know Jimmy Newton? I think they called him Jimbo. Yeah, Jimbo.
Jimbo. Yeah, I know what I mean. Did he play much around here?
